reason: The compact monoclinic cell (about 7.805 x 4.507 x 6.938 A, beta about 112.035 degrees) and likely Z=4 are well supported by indexing, but the exact submitted P1 structure is not. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trace optimized a custom reflection-intensity objective rather than demonstrating a credible whole-profile fit. More decisively, selected.cif is chemically implausible: its minimum distance is 1.198 A, with multiple very short anion-anion contacts and Sr-anion/Ta-anion contacts near 1.4-1.6 A. The trajectory's own refinement outputs expose similarly impossible contacts. Symmetry and ordering are also unresolved: higher-symmetry trials were limited, P1 was adopted as an unconstrained realization, and numerous O/N assignments have essentially indistinguishable objective values (the leading alternatives differ by only about 2e-5). Thus the data may support the cell and an average layered framework, but not the submitted symmetry, coordinates, or explicit O/N ordering; a scientifically motivated attempt using chemically constrained models and proper whole-pattern comparisons is warranted.
